title: At least 9 civilians killed in Russian attacks; Russia claims over 1,200 drones shot down
detail: Ukraine reported at least nine civilians killed in Russian attacks, while Russia's defence ministry claimed it intercepted more than 1,200 drones, described as a near-record figure. Details of locations and the exact timeframe were not specified in the aggregated report.

media.caption: At least nine civilians killed in Ukraine as Russia claims near-record drone interceptions
